sources.title: A Lattice Model of Secure Information Flow
overlap: Formalizes which information flows are permitted by a security lattice and supports automatic certification of secure flow.
Shows that preventing unauthorized semantic/information amplification through composition is a decades-old formal security problem.
non_overlap: Does not model decision intent, responsibility or provenance receipts.
Does not provide the Matawaka cross-domain decision/action vocabulary.

sources.title: Belief, Awareness, and Limited Reasoning
overlap: Separates awareness from belief and explicitly models agents with bounded/local reasoning.
Establishes that what exists logically need not be what an agent is aware of or reasons with.
non_overlap: Does not model decision authority or responsibility.
Does not provide auditable heterogeneous resource receipts.

sources.title: Polymorphic Effect Systems
overlap: Makes side effects first-class static descriptions distinct from value types and regions.
Supports conservative approximation and masking of unobservable effects.
non_overlap: Effects are program effects, not epistemic non-claims of an evidence receipt.
Does not define cross-receipt evidence composition.

sources.title: Intention Is Choice with Commitment
overlap: Formally separates beliefs, goals, actions and intentions and models commitment conditions.
Explicitly avoids treating all foreseen side effects as intended effects.
non_overlap: Does not model cryptographic authority or execution permits.
Does not provide provenance or receipt schemas.

sources.title: Information-Theoretic Estimation of Individual Consideration Set
sources.date_basis: International Journal of Research in Marketing publication date: May 1995.
overlap: Partitions an awareness set into considered and non-considered alternatives.
Directly predates the distinction between what is available/known and what enters serious consideration.
non_overlap: Alternatives are not heterogeneous intelligence resources with provenance.
Does not connect consideration to authority or responsibility.

sources.title: A Decentralized Model for Information Flow Control
overlap: Separates decentralized authority over information from code execution and controls declassification/flow.
Uses static certification so authority labels constrain composition and dissemination.
non_overlap: Does not represent authorship, decision responsibility or successor receipts.
Information-flow authority is narrower than Matawaka decision/action semantics.

sources.title: A Proof-Carrying Authorization System
overlap: Authorization is established by a proof checked against distributed policy before access/action rather than trusted behavioral intent.
Proof components and goals compose under explicit logic rather than implicit privilege amplification.
non_overlap: PCA is an authorization mechanism, not a full decision epistemics/provenance stack.
Does not model authorship or outcome/successor provenance.

sources.title: The BOID Architecture: Conflicts Between Beliefs, Obligations, Intentions and Desires
overlap: Maintains beliefs, obligations, intentions and desires as distinct components with conflict resolution.
Contains feedback loops that consider effects before commitment to action.
non_overlap: Obligation is not identical to cryptographic authority/responsibility binding.
Does not define evidence or provenance receipt lineage.

sources.title: Local Reasoning about Programs that Alter Data Structures
overlap: Formalizes local reasoning and frame-style preservation of state outside the footprint of an operation.
Demonstrates that explicit non-change/preserved-state reasoning is foundational program logic.
non_overlap: Frame reasoning concerns mutable program state rather than evidence semantics.
Does not attach human-readable non-claims to heterogeneous receipts.

sources.title: A Calculus for Composing Security Policies
overlap: Provides formal policy composition for runtime monitors that transform or terminate disallowed action sequences.
Directly predates the idea that composed valid policy/evidence layers require explicit semantics to avoid interference.
non_overlap: Security-policy composition is narrower than heterogeneous epistemic/authority/provenance composition.
Does not model human-AI authorship.

sources.title: Provenance Semirings
overlap: Defines an algebra for composing provenance annotations across relational operations.
Shows that provenance itself had a general compositional semantics well before Matawaka.
non_overlap: Database provenance annotations do not represent intent, authority or responsibility.
Does not prohibit semantic promotion between heterogeneous governance claim types.

sources.title: The Open Provenance Model Core Specification v1.1
sources.date_basis: Future Generation Computer Systems publication date: June 2011; an accepted manuscript was publicly deposited earlier.
overlap: Defines technology-agnostic provenance for any thing, digital or otherwise, with interoperable inference rules.
Is explicitly cross-domain rather than tied to one content or action application.
non_overlap: OPM records execution provenance and does not provide a pre-action authorization gate.
Does not model awareness/consideration as decision-time epistemic relations.

sources.title: W3C PROV Data Model / PROV Ontology
overlap: Represents Entities, Activities and Agents; a Plan is intended actions/steps for goals; association assigns responsibility; delegation assigns authority and responsibility for a specific activity.
Supports people, organizations and software agents in a domain-neutral provenance model.
Explicitly records that an agent may rely on a plan in an activity and that plans themselves have provenance.
non_overlap: PROV is descriptive provenance rather than a fail-closed pre-action authorization protocol.
It does not model resource availability versus consideration as separate required relations.

sources.title: in-toto: Providing Farm-to-Table Guarantees for Bits and Bytes
overlap: Project owners specify an expected multi-step layout and authorized functionaries; performed steps emit signed link metadata for commands, materials and products.
Verifiers compare observed execution/artifact lineage against the authorized expected chain.
non_overlap: The domain is software supply-chain integrity rather than general human-AI decision governance.
Does not model consideration or responsibility acceptance as separate epistemic/authority states.
